kpiDefinitions.backlog-aging: Open work grouped by how much of its own target it has used: within 50%, 50 to 100%, or over 100%. Targets differ by workflow, so age in days alone would mislead.
kpiDefinitions.em-excursion-rate: Environmental monitoring results at alert or action level, divided by all environmental monitoring results that have a level. The alert-level and action-level rates are also shown separately. A trend flag appears when the alert-level rate is above 2.5% or the action-level rate is above 0.15%, with at least 5 results.
kpiDefinitions.incubation-reads-on-time: Share of completed incubation windows that were read no later than the expected reading time plus a 4 hour grace.
kpiDefinitions.on-time-all-stages: Share of approved samples that met every stage target: analyst stage within the longest per-workflow target of the sample's assigned tests (7 days where no target is configured), then review within 24 h and approval within 24 h, for every section you can see.
kpiDefinitions.oos-rate: Samples that belong to an out-of-specification group, divided by all samples that received an approval decision in the period. The retest rate is a subset of this figure. This is a laboratory quality signal, not an analyst penalty.
kpiDefinitions.retest-rate: Samples with a 'retest retained sample' decision, divided by all samples that received an approval decision in the period. It is a subset of the OOS rate. It describes the laboratory, not an individual analyst.
kpiDefinitions.returns-by-test: Number of times a test was returned to the analyst in the period, grouped by test code in alphabetical order. A return is a reviewer sending a result back; it is a process signal and is never grouped by person.
kpiDefinitions.right-first-time: Work units of approved tests that were never returned to the analyst, divided by the work units of all approved tests. Tests without a work-unit profile are left out and listed as a gap; they are never given a default weight.
kpiDefinitions.sample-tat: Median calendar days from receipt to final approval, with the 90th percentile alongside. Percentiles are linearly interpolated.
kpiDefinitions.stage-tat: Median and 90th percentile days spent in testing, incubation, review and approval for samples approved in the period. This is a breakdown: read the stage values, there is no single headline number. Incubation runs inside testing, so the stages overlap.
kpiDefinitions.wip-backlog: Tests that are open right now: waiting, running or incubating. Tests that have a result and wait for review or approval are shown in the backlog aging section instead.
